# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `swarms` MCP server pointing at the Swarms Marketplace hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://swarms.world/mcp`).
- Auth is a Swarms API key sent as a Bearer token, set through the `SWARMS_API_KEY` plugin variable.
- Logo: Swarms' hexagon mark from The Swarm Corporation GitHub organization avatar, 256×256.
